name: Claude Cowork — Built-In Browser
hook: Anthropic shipped a built-in browser inside Claude Cowork on August 26 — no Chrome extension, nothing shared from your personal session. When a task needs a website, a browser pane opens and Claude navigates, reads, clicks, and fills forms without leaving the app. Rolling out now to Pro, Max, and Team on macOS/Windows/Linux; Enterprise already live.

name: Claude Code v2.1.247–250 — cost-optimize, --restricted, cross-session on Bedrock/Vertex
hook: v2.1.247 (Aug 26) adds `/claude-api cost-optimize` for profiling and reducing API spend plus a new SendFeedback tool. v2.1.248 (Aug 27) ships `--restricted` mode — strips Bash, code-execution, and WebFetch tools, keeps file tools inside cwd, and refuses bypassPermissions, making sandboxed CI deployments viable. Cross-session messaging (SendMessage/ListAgents) now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and telemetry-disabled configs. v2.1.250 (today) brings reliability fixes.
